purpose: AM1: qualify current use while retaining original historical evidence

assumptions: Single observation, UTC or offset-aware timestamps
No FX/dependency/calculation expiry qualification in this slice
No entitlement, source quality or market-session completeness inferred
guarantees: Fresh only before observed_at + ttd_seconds and after availability/ingestion
Expired data remains historical evidence; input bytes unchanged
Missing value is unavailable; future observation is conflicted
A supplied freshness_status label is not trusted as current truth

Precedence: not yet available/ingested -> unavailable; otherwise future observation -> conflicted; otherwise missing value -> unavailable; then expiry. Combined future observation and missing value is conflicted.

children.purpose: Check shape and actual timezone-aware timestamps
Apply current-use semantics independent of historical retention

archive_comparison.schema: Run pinned archived schema to demonstrate shape acceptance, not freshness truth
archive_comparison.runtime: Call only pinned observations.state; no append/replay/write functions invoked
archive_comparison.intentional_delta: Reject current-use inference from a supplied fresh label when expired. Archived runtime already distinguishes stale; retain that useful behavior without requiring implementation reuse.
archive_comparison.test_model: Independent small reference function in run.py; not a new deployed module or universal workflow interpreter

acceptance: Seven representative outcomes agree with current intent and observed archived runtime
Original observations unchanged; schemas and runtime source hashes match pins
Invalid result shape and contradictory state/eligibility pairs fail output schema
limits: No runtime wiring, historical data ingestion, provider call, queue write or replacement rollout
Nested composition is represented and manually staged in test harness, not executed by a general engine
